purpose: Causal, commitment-aware FairFlex study. Real Caltech ACN sessions supply declared energy requests and declared departures; the controller never receives a future realized unplug time. The IEEE-33/PV scenario remains a controlled sensitivity, not Caltech's physical feeder.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in, use the earliest complete user-declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture. The historical disconnectTime is a hidden realised environment event and is never a controller planning input.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude unclaimed sessions from the primary user-satisfaction analysis; evaluate missing-commitment imputation only as a separately declared robustness study.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy, not historical kWhDelivered.

commitment_uncertainty.deployment_rule: Subtract the calibration-derived early-departure buffer from each declared deadline, but never before one control step after arrival.
commitment_uncertainty.selection_protocol: The method and 10% risk level are locked before the held-out test replay. The calibration split fits the buffer; the test split only evaluates it.
commitment_uncertainty.scope: Global marginal coverage under an exchangeability assumption; this is not a per-driver guarantee and is evaluated as a simple, reproducible baseline before any conditional model.

duration_stratification.selection_note: This is an interpretable exploratory extension. Select between candidate modes using development replication only, then freeze the choice before final seasonal evaluation. Sparse groups fall back to the global guard.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real ACN sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations; this is an explicit experiment assumption.

solar_data.note: Approximate Caltech/Pasadena solar-resource proxy; it is not measured rooftop PV output.

pv_proxy_sensitivity.note: PVWatts GHI proxy for controlled sensitivity experiments; it is not measured Caltech PV production.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Deliberately severe shared feeder-import budget to create scarcity; it is not Caltech's measured feeder limit.
